title: Tenango Otomi – TIPs
text: Tenango Otomi: “earnestly live good” (source: Tenango Otomi Back Translation). Hausa: “character of goodness” (Hausa Common Language Back Translation). Mandarin Chinese: déxíng 德行 or “moral behavior” (Protestant) / yìlì 毅力 or “willpower” (Catholic).

title: Otomi, Tenango Language (OTN)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Tenango Otomi is a stable indigenous language of Mexico. It belongs to the Otomanguean language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
